lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Why do I feel like you're about to ask me for something?

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Relax! I was just going to say hi.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: ...Okay, fine. I was also going to ask if you've seen my pen.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: The blue one. It's my lucky pen.
